judge: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5, fresh
critique: It is short, plain and gives a clear order the way Nox's mentors do. Still, the Undead-held watchtower outside the walls fits no campaign opening I recognise, the speaker calls the player both 'lad' and 'young sir', and the reminder ('precious little time left to stop [Person]') is generic fantasy filler instead of a Westwood line.
